result.description: The LumaWave Arc 27Q is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for general office, creative, and home productivity use. It features a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel, 75Hz refresh rate, thin bezels, and adaptive brightness for comfortable all-day viewing. The monitor includes HDMI and DisplayPort inputs, a height-adjustable stand, and built-in stereo speakers for a tidy workstation setup. Its emphasis is on everyday visual clarity and ergonomic flexibility rather than specialized gaming or workstation acceleration.
